solution_summary: Learn how Amazon Bedrock helped symplr optimize healthcare operations. Healthcare workers are the beating heart of our communities, improving the lives and well-being of citizens every day. Yet life on the frontline is a constant battle of complexity and competing tasks. Endless paperwork diminishes their time caring for patients and ongoing workforce shortages mean that staff are increasingly stretched thin. Inefficient operations drain hospital resources, damage productivity, and even impact quality of care. Disconnected point systems across healthcare have long been the culprit for administrative overload and bottlenecks. symplr is streamlining healthcare operations with artificial intelligence (AI) on AWS. By connecting and optimizing disparate systems, and empowering staff with intelligent solutions, healthcare workers can spend less time on tedious manual tasks, and more time delivering an exceptional level of care.
